tasks.label: DH: 2. gerar dados de exemplo
tasks.command: docker compose run --rm cli python scripts/generate_sample_data.py --out data/landing/sample

tasks.label: DH: 3. ingerir todas as fontes
tasks.command: docker compose run --rm cli python -m datahack_ingest run --all

tasks.label: DH: 3b. ingerir uma fonte
tasks.command: docker compose run --rm cli python -m datahack_ingest run ${input:source}

tasks.label: DH: 3c. perfilar fonte (dry-run, não grava)
tasks.command: docker compose run --rm cli python -m datahack_ingest run ${input:source} --dry-run

tasks.label: DH: 4. dbt build
tasks.command: docker compose run --rm cli dbt build --project-dir dbt

tasks.label: DH: 4b. dbt build (seletor)
tasks.command: docker compose run --rm cli dbt build --project-dir dbt --select ${input:dbtSelect}

tasks.label: DH: dbt docs generate
tasks.command: docker compose run --rm cli bash -c "DBT_TARGET_PATH=/opt/datahack/dbt/target dbt docs generate --project-dir dbt"

tasks.label: DH: validar catálogo de fontes
tasks.command: docker compose run --rm cli python -m datahack_ingest validate

tasks.label: DH: lint (ruff + sqlfluff)
tasks.command: ruff check . && ruff format --check . && sqlfluff lint dbt/models

windows.command: ruff check .; ruff format --check .; sqlfluff lint dbt/models
